name: Bookwhen
description_en:
Bookwhen is a web-based booking service centered on dated events and tickets: classes, multi-day courses, activities and other sessions can appear on a hosted schedule. Attendees choose tickets, supply booking information and check out; an organizer manages capacity and attendance.

Its basket can represent several events or several attendees in one booking. That matters when evaluating booking quotas: a booking, ticket and attendee are not interchangeable business concepts. The final billing interpretation and the selected plan should be confirmed for your actual pattern.
description_zh:
Bookwhen 是以日期明确的活动和票种为中心的网页预约服务：班课、多日课程、体验活动及其他场次可以放在托管日程页。参与者选票、填写资料并结算，组织者管理名额与出勤。

购物篮支持一次预约包含多个活动或多位参与者。评估预约额度时必须注意：预约、票和参与者并非同一业务概念，应按实际使用模式确认最终计量方式与套餐。

core_features.name_en: Ticket basket for events and attendees
core_features.name_zh: 多活动及参与者票务购物篮
core_features.explanation_en: A booking can contain multiple tickets and attendees, including different events.
core_features.explanation_zh: 一次预约可包含不同活动的多张票及多位参与者。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure how long a customer may respond when a space becomes available; requires an eligible plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可设置名额空出后的客户响应时限；需适用套餐。

core_features.explanation_en: Maintain a register and export bookings and attendances as CSV.
core_features.explanation_zh: 维护签到表，并以 CSV 导出预约及出勤。

All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: a weekly workshop and a course
sections.title_zh: 示例：每周工作坊与连续课程
sections.en:
A workshop organizer can create a recurring event and distinguish individual, group or course tickets. A family booking may need separate attendee details even though one person pays. The feature page describes custom forms, child/adult distinctions and multi-ticket checkout, so evaluate the actual information captured for each attendee.

Try a booking that includes two people and two dates. Inspect the register, payment and exported rows, and then transfer one eligible ticket. This suggested check tests the event model; it is not a performed transaction or a promise that every ticket type has identical transfer rules.
sections.zh:
工作坊组织者可以创建重复活动，并区分个人票、团体票或课程票。家庭预约即使由一人付款，也可能需要分别填写参与者资料。功能页介绍自定义表单、儿童/成人区分及多票结算，因此应核对每位参与者实际收集哪些资料。

建议试一次包含两个人、两个日期的预约，检查签到表、付款及导出行，再转移一张符合条件的票。这是检验活动模型的建议，未经实际交易，也不保证所有票种转移规则相同。

sections.en:
The product supports customer-managed cancellation/transfers and automated waitlists. The feature page lets the organizer set the response window after a place opens. That is operationally different from immediately giving every interested customer a guaranteed seat.

Confirmation emails can contain a management link and calendar file. Reminder emails and waiting lists appear from Standard in the pricing view rather than on Free or Lite. For a full class, verify the release, notification and acceptance sequence before promising customers a particular queue policy.
sections.zh:
产品支持客户自助取消/转移及自动候补。功能页允许组织者设置空位出现后的响应窗口，这与立即保证每位有意客户获得名额不同。

确认邮件可含管理链接及日历文件。读取的定价视图从 Standard 起列出提醒邮件和候补，Free 或 Lite 未列出。对于满员班课，应先验证名额释放、通知和接受的顺序，再向客户承诺具体候补规则。

sections.title_en: Free events and paid subscription capacity
sections.en:
The GBP view lists Free with 50 bookings per month, one team member and one booking page, restricted to free events. Monthly Lite, Standard and Plus show £12, £19 and £39 before displayed VAT, with 300, 800 and 1,800 monthly bookings respectively. Their team/page allowances also rise. Annual totals are shown separately; they should not be confused with month-to-month payment.

Online customer payments incur a separate payment-provider processing fee. Free bookings and bookings marked paid offline carry no processing fee according to the page. The trial lasts two weeks without a credit card; the homepage says the account switches to Free afterward. A free subscription therefore does not support indefinitely selling paid tickets.
sections.zh:
英镑视图列出 Free 每月 50 次预约、一位团队成员、一个预约页，仅限免费活动。月付 Lite、Standard、Plus 分别为 £12、£19、£39，另加页面显示的增值税，每月预约额度分别为 300、800、1,800 次，团队与页面额度也递增。年付总额单独显示，不应混同按月付款。

客户在线付款另有支付服务商处理费。页面表示免费预约及标记线下已付款的预约不收处理费。试用为两周，无需信用卡；首页表示之后转入 Free。因此不能通过免费订阅长期出售收费票。

sections.title_en: Build a schedule and protect attendee data
sections.title_zh: 搭建日程并保护参与者资料
sections.en:
The documented starting path is to create an account, add events, connect a suitable payment route, customize a booking page, and share or embed it. Decide the event capacity, ticket availability and form fields before distribution. For calendar feeds, choose deliberately between public and private variants: the feature description makes attendee-name inclusion a privacy choice.

Bookwhen lists Zoom generation, online joining instructions and video embeds. They support the event journey; they do not establish that Bookwhen hosts the underlying video call. Confirm the specific integration entitlement and delivery conditions. If an email is missing or a payment looks incomplete, inspect the booking/provider records before resubmitting a charge.
sections.zh:
文档介绍的入门路径是注册账户、添加活动、连接适当支付路径、定制预约页，然后分享或嵌入。分发前应确定活动容量、票种开放条件与表单字段。日历订阅需主动选择公开或私有形式：功能说明把是否包含参与者姓名作为隐私选项。

Bookwhen 列出 Zoom 会议生成、在线加入说明及视频嵌入。这些支持活动流程，但不能证明底层视频通话由 Bookwhen 托管。应核对具体集成权益与交付条件。邮件未到或付款不完整时，先检查预约及支付服务商记录，再考虑重新扣款。

sections.title_zh: 活动模型适合什么情况
sections.en:
Class and activity organizers should evaluate the ticket model, attendance exports and page permissions together. A buyer primarily needing arbitrary staff shifts or a full hotel property system must establish those requirements separately; this research does not infer them from the scheduling category. The public product is hosted and web-based; no self-hosted distribution or software redistribution licence was verified.

API availability is described for integrating event data into a website. Do not assume that this means every administrative operation is writable through the API. Review endpoints, credentials and failure handling before a custom integration.
sections.zh:
班课与活动组织者应一起评估票种模型、出勤导出及页面权限。主要需要任意员工排班或完整酒店管理系统的买家，须另行确认这些要求；本文不会从排程分类推导这些能力。公开产品为托管网页服务，未核实自托管发行版或软件再分发许可。

API 说明用于把活动数据集成到网站，不能因此认定所有后台操作都能通过 API 写入。自定义集成前应核对端点、凭据与失败处理。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Quota counting for multi-attendee baskets, refund policies, payment-region eligibility and API write coverage need detailed confirmation; no transaction was run.
research_gaps.zh: 多人购物篮的额度计数、退款政策、支付地区资格及 API 写入覆盖需进一步确认；未实际交易。

research_gaps.en: Pricing and feature pages name overlapping but not identical gateway choices; confirm currently supported gateways in the target account.
research_gaps.zh: 定价和功能页列出的网关不完全一致，需在目标账户确认当前支持情况。
